name: Aisling Sturbridge
source:
Aisling Sturbridge is the High [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Regent_(Tremere)]Regent[/url] of the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Chantry_of_the_Five_Boroughs]Chantry of the Five Boroughs[/url], which makes her, in theory, the most influential [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Tremere_(VTM)]Tremere[/url] in New York City.

[Spoiler]Her prior focus on research and furthering the Pyramid's plans is losing ground to politics, and her position could become less and less stable with time.

She is compromising not just her personal interests, but also, occasionally, a bit of dignity, which is briefly put into focus during the Celebrations of Power.[/spoiler]

[Edited from the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1405990/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Shadows_of_New_York_Artbook]Artbook[/url]]
